descriptions.sa2-nx: Sonic Adventure 2 (Xbox Live Arcade) running natively on Nintendo Switch: static recompilation with ReXGlue and a native deko3d renderer, 60 FPS at stock clocks
descriptions.MarathonRecomp-NX: An unofficial Switch homebrew port of the Xbox 360 version of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006), created through static recompilation.
descriptions.marble-blast-gold: Marble Blast Gold on Switch, built from MBHaxe, a Haxe port of the Marble Blast games.
descriptions.marble-blast-platinum: Marble Blast Platinum on Switch, built from MBHaxe, a Haxe port of the Marble Blast games. Multiplayer isn't supported.
descriptions.marble-blast-platinumquest: PlatinumQuest on Switch, built from MBHaxe, a Haxe port of the Marble Blast games.
descriptions.marble-blast-ultra: Marble Blast Ultra on Switch, built from MBHaxe, a Haxe port of the Marble Blast games. Multiplayer isn't supported yet.

needs.burgershop2_nx: You must own Burger Shop 2 on Android.
needs.guwange-nx: You need your own copy of the game, dumped from your own console.
needs.ketsui-nx: You need your own copy of the game, dumped from your own disc.
needs.keflings-nx: You need your own copy of the game: its Xbox Live Arcade package from an Xbox 360, and title update 2.
needs.nights-nx: You need your own copy of the game: its Xbox Live Arcade package from an Xbox 360, and its title update.
needs.poinpy_nx: You need files from POINPY 1.1.17, which is a free download from its official listing.
